name: Level_1 - Task_8
description: Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Construct a bulk conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (Cu) with a lattice parameter a = 3.615 Å, and expand it into a 3 × 3 × 3 supercell to yield exactly 108 Cu atoms. Initialize the atomic velocities for a temperature of 600 K following a Maxwell-Boltzmann distribution and zero out the center-of-mass momentum without otherwise rescaling the velocities. Set up an isothermal-isobaric (NPT) molecular dynamics simulation using an appropriate NPT integrator. Configure the dynamics with a target temperature of 600 K, an external pressure of 1.01325 bar, a timestep of 1.0 fs, a thermostat time constant (ttime) of 25 fs, and a barostat factor (pfactor) of 2e6 GPa × fs². Run 2000 equilibration steps without collecting volumes. Then run exactly 1000 additional production steps, recording the cell volume once per production step, and return the average cell volume (in Å³) computed on those 1000 recorded volumes.
